title: osf verify becomes a moon-driven checkpoint runner
summary: `osf verify` stops running checks in-process and becomes a checkpoint runner: it selects this repository's moon tasks by tag (hook, pre-commit, pre-push, pull-request, schedule), hands moon the affected file list over stdin, and reads moon's run report plus each task's SARIF back to decide pass/fail. A new `osf check <name>` command exposes each individual check (scan, scan-staged, lint-writing, lint-skill, scan-commits) so a moon task can run one at a time, and a new hash-chained journal records one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Supporting work: git calls are scrubbed of inherited GIT_* variables, `osf hooks install` writes hook scripts outside the repo, and a `hook post-tool` event runs the hook checkpoint on a just-written file.

lanes.subtitle: git hooks, agents, CI

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The osf binary: the checkpoint runner, the per-check command, the moon adapter, the journal, and the git layer.

lanes.label: moon
lanes.subtitle: task runner

lanes.label: Artifacts

nodes.label: git hook scripts
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push
nodes.summary: Shell scripts that exec osf. The devcontainer's own hooks now call `osf verify --checkpoint pre-commit|pre-push`, and `osf hooks install` writes the same shape to a folder outside the repository.

nodes.label: agent post-tool hook
nodes.subtitle: osf hook post-tool
nodes.summary: A coding agent's PostToolUse event, carrying the path of a file just written. It runs the hook checkpoint on that one file and refuses the write on an error finding.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: pull_request only
nodes.summary: A GitHub Actions job that installs moon, builds osf, and runs `osf verify --checkpoint pull-request --base origin/<base_ref>`, uploading the journal buffer and SARIF output as evidence.

nodes.label: osf verify
nodes.subtitle: --checkpoint
nodes.summary: The entry point every gate calls. It now detects adoption, resolves the checkpoint, and delegates to the checkpoint runner instead of running checks itself.

nodes.label: checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves the base and file list for a checkpoint, writes the OSF_FILES_FROM list and its hash, clears stale SARIF, runs moon under a report lock, and turns the run report into a summary plus journal events.

nodes.label: osf check <name>
nodes.subtitle: scan, scan-staged, lint-writing, lint-skill, scan-commits
nodes.summary: Runs one check over an explicit file list, reading files from the command line, else OSF_FILES_FROM. At the hook checkpoint it reads disk; at every other checkpoint it reads git HEAD. Writes SARIF when asked.

nodes.label: moon adapter
nodes.subtitle: moon.rs
nodes.summary: Spawns `moon run :#<tag> --affected --stdin`, feeds the file list on stdin, enforces a minimum version and a timeout, and parses moon's run report and `query tasks` output.

nodes.label: journal
nodes.subtitle: hash-chained JSONL
nodes.summary: Appends one verification event per task and one checkpoint-complete event to a per-run buffer file, each event chained to the previous by SHA-256 over a payload with timing and cache fields neutralised.

nodes.label: git layer
nodes.subtitle: git.rs
nodes.summary: Every git call now scrubs inherited GIT_* variables, keeping GIT_INDEX_FILE only when it lies inside the target repository's own git directory. Adds upstream_ref, commits_since, staged_blob_hash, files_at, and local config read/write.

nodes.label: osf hooks install
nodes.subtitle: githooks.rs
nodes.summary: Writes pre-commit, commit-msg and pre-push scripts to a folder outside the repository and points core.hooksPath at it; `--check` reports whether that is already the case.

nodes.label: moon CLI
nodes.subtitle: pinned 2.5.5
nodes.summary: The task runner, pinned by version and checksum in the devcontainer and in a CI action. It selects tasks by tag, hashes inputs, and writes a run report.

nodes.label: osf moon tasks
nodes.subtitle: .osf/moon.yml
nodes.summary: One task per check per checkpoint, tagged osf-hook, osf-pre-commit, osf-pre-push or osf-pull-request, each declaring inputs, outputs and a slot tag.

nodes.label: journal buffer
nodes.subtitle: <state>/buffer/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: One JSONL file per run under the state directory, holding the hash-chained verification and checkpoint-complete events.

nodes.label: SARIF output
nodes.subtitle: .osf/out/<task>.sarif
nodes.summary: Each check task writes its findings as SARIF 2.1.0 here; the checkpoint runner clears these before a run and reads them back after, counting only unsuppressed results.

nodes.label: moon cache and run report
nodes.subtitle: .moon/cache/
nodes.summary: Moon's own cache state and its single runReport.json per workspace, which the adapter reads and which the report lock protects from overlapping runs.

edges.label: osf verify --checkpoint
edges.summary: A git hook execs osf verify with a checkpoint name; the old --stage flag still maps onto it.

edges.label: hook checkpoint on one file
edges.summary: The post-tool event resolves the written file's repository, checks adoption, and runs the hook checkpoint over that one path.

edges.label: pull-request checkpoint
edges.summary: The CI job runs the pull-request checkpoint against the base branch ref.

edges.label: run(req, state_dir)
edges.summary: The change's centre: verify no longer runs checks itself, it hands a Request to the checkpoint runner.

edges.label: moon::run_holding
edges.summary: The runner asks the adapter to run the checkpoint's tag, holding the report lock across the run and the SARIF read-back.

edges.label: moon run :#<tag> --affected --stdin
edges.summary: The adapter spawns moon with the affected file list on stdin, after checking the version and clearing the stale run report.

edges.label: selects by tag
edges.summary: Moon resolves the tag to the tasks that carry it and decides which are affected by the changed files.

edges.label: osf check <name> --checkpoint
edges.summary: Each task's command is one osf check invocation, with its own checkpoint and SARIF output path.

edges.label: --sarif-out
edges.summary: A check writes its findings as SARIF, creating parent folders; an empty file list still writes an empty results array.

edges.label: HEAD content, index content
edges.summary: At every checkpoint but the hook, a check reads file content from git HEAD; scan-staged always reads the index.

edges.label: clear, then read back
edges.summary: Stale SARIF is deleted before moon runs and read back after, so a leftover file is never mistaken for this run's result.

edges.label: one event per task
edges.summary: Each task's result becomes a verification event, followed by one checkpoint-complete event carrying the slot table.

edges.label: append JSONL
edges.summary: Events are appended one per line to the run's own buffer file, each carrying the previous event's hash.

edges.label: runReport.json
edges.summary: The adapter clears the stale report before the run and parses the fresh one after, under a lock file beside it.

edges.label: core.hooksPath
edges.summary: Install writes the scripts and sets the repository's local core.hooksPath to their folder.

flows.title: A pre-push checkpoint run
flows.summary: What happens when a pre-push hook fires: osf resolves the pushed-to ref, hands the changed files to moon, and journals what each tagged task decided.

messages.label: resolve base: upstream ref, else empty tree
messages.note: With no --base, pre-push falls back to the ref it actually pushes against; a first push with no remote ref compares against the empty tree, so everything it sends is checked.

messages.label: write OSF_FILES_FROM, hash it
messages.note: The file list goes to a per-run temp file; its SHA-256 becomes OSF_FILES_HASH, a moon input.

messages.label: moon run :#osf-pre-push --affected --stdin
messages.note: The adapter holds the report lock, clears the stale run report, and writes the file list to moon's stdin.

messages.label: osf check scan --checkpoint pre-push --sarif-out ...
messages.note: One invocation per tagged task; each reads its file list from OSF_FILES_FROM and writes SARIF.

messages.label: runReport.json
messages.note: The adapter parses each task's status, duration, cache hit and moon's own failure reason.

messages.label: verification per task, then checkpoint-complete
messages.note: A task that failed with no readable SARIF records unknown findings, never zero.

messages.label: exit 0 / 1 / 2
messages.note: 0 ran clean or nothing to check, 1 at least one task failed, 2 could not run.
